title: Flagged for Review — irregularities, unverified values and unresolved references
policy: Every flag is non-blocking per the standing instruction. Each carries what is known, the official source consulted, and what would clear it. Blank values are never inferred.

rows.detail: Requirement bodies cite VR-04..VR-26 and VQ-05..VQ-08 (e.g. REQ-47 'VR-08, VR-12'). No file in this repository defines these IDs. They cannot be verified or resolved here.
rows.clears_when: Owner supplies the tracker export (DEC-R7) or confirms they are external-only

rows.detail: This session counted 347 rows / 28 tables / 67 Out at 2026-11-15T~23:35Z. Earlier sessions saw 254 and 279. All were correct at their fetch times; the page evolves daily. Only the ledger makes them comparable.

rows.flag: Daiyan Henley listed by LAC after trade to DEN
rows.detail: Official transactions show Henley traded LAC->DEN on 11/10; the official LAC Week-10 injury report on 11/15 still lists him (Full Participation, no designation). Both links retained; no correction invented.

rows.flag: TreVeyon Henderson listed on the report while on injured reserve
rows.detail: Official roundup (Sat Nov 14) says the Patriots placed Henderson on IR; the official report still lists him (Out). 'On the report' and 'on the reserve list' are different facts that must be joined (REQ-13/62).
rows.clears_when: reserve-list join lands in the ledger (implemented in workflow, first run pending)

rows.detail: Only Munich (NE@DET) was stated on the pages read this session. Every other Week-10 venue is left blank — the game-centre pages were not read and will not be guessed.
NFL publishes no odds; every market line in the repo is third-party or blank. This blocks REQ-04/18/58/59 at DR-G1.

rows.flag: Open PR #93 predates this session by >24h
rows.detail: PR #93 (arena/582300df-own4, nfl-command-center) has been open since 2026-11-13 22:43 UTC with no merge; per the 60-minute stale-claim rule it is takeover-eligible, but this session does not need its scope and leaves it untouched.
rows.clears_when: owner merges/closes #93 or a session takes it over

rows.flag: Requirement REQ-48's '279 rows live' superseded by later captures
rows.detail: The brief's live-count figures (254/279) matched their capture times; this session's live count is 347 (SEA 15, CIN 9 — both now listing players, consistent with the fix's intent). Published numbers carry fetch timestamps so no capture is 'wrong'.

The 90-minute rule is verified from the rulebook (Rule 1 §2 Art. 1(o)); whether the NFL publishes each game's roof decision as structured data was not verifiable this session. REQ-57's roof column stays blank until a publication surface is found.
rows.clears_when: n=1 verified publication surface for game-day roof designations

rows.detail: REQ-64's historical designation archive exists only in a community-maintained repository. Any ingest must label provenance and keep official links where possible.
rows.clears_when: owner accepts trusted-not-official labelling for historical designations (DEC needed)

rows.flag: Schedule page week label vs brief's 'Week 11' usage in earlier sessions
rows.detail: The current slate (Nov 12-16) is REG 10 on nfl.com (pager WEEK 10, game slugs 2026-reg-10). Earlier sessions' 'Week 11' references pointed at the genuinely next week (Nov 19+, reg-11) — verified in nfl-book's slate. No defect found; recorded to prevent future week-labeling confusion.

rows.flag: Raw-HTML capture of the injury report is unverified until first workflow run
rows.detail: nfl.com pages may be JS-rendered; the capture script detects missing report markup and fails loudly (REQ-61). Whether the raw HTML contains parseable tables is only provable on a runner; the first scheduled run will demonstrate it.
rows.clears_when: n=1 successful scheduled run with parsed rows (or a logged loud failure with the fallback decision)
